body.resource_hint: For F_T(nu)=int_0^T exp(i nu t)dt, the energy-diagonal tree-loop interference divides the ordered second-Dyson integral by the one-vertex duration T and gives Kdisp_T(d)=int_0^T(1-t/T)sin(dt)dt=1/d-sin(dT)/(T d^2). This is the Hilbert transform of the normalized Fejer kernel |F_T|^2/(2 pi T). Convolving log|omega-a| gives log|E-a|+C(T|E-a|), C(z)=sin(z)/z-Ci(z). Therefore B_T(P)=B_MSbar(P)-C(T|P0-|P||)-C(T|P0+|P||).
